definitions.gloss: book spine; spine of a book
definitions.explanation: The narrow side of a book visible when it is shelved, typically displaying the title, author, and publisher.

examples.japanese: {背表紙|せびょうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タイトル→タイトル：03855_taitoru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧にくい。
examples.english: The title on the spine is hard to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背表紙|せびょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}める→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like looking at the spines of books on the bookshelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{背表紙|せびょうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日焼|ひや}けして→日焼けする：20314_hiyakesuru⟧⟦{色|いろ}あせている→色あせる：16726_iroaseru⟧。
examples.english: The spines of old books have faded from sun exposure.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧ (back) + ⟦{表紙|ひょうし}→表紙：04351_hyoushi⟧ (cover). Note the reading change: ⟦{表紙|ひょうし}→表紙：04351_hyoushi⟧ becomes びょうし in this compound due to rendaku (sequential voicing).

USAGE:
In Japanese bookbinding, text on the spine traditionally reads from top to bottom. This is relevant when shelving books, as the text orientation differs from Western books.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{表紙|ひょうし}→表紙：04351_hyoushi⟧: (front) cover of a book
- ⟦{裏表紙|うらびょうし}→裏表紙：28412_urabyoushi⟧: back cover
